gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 52.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Extension of Yin Chong Street in an easterly direction for a distance of approximately 75 yards terminating at its junction with Kwong Wa Street as shown coloured burnt sienna on Plan No. R.K. 533. English Name: YIN CHONG STREET. Chinese Name: 煙廠街.

No. 52.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road about 40 yards to the west of Kwong Wa Street and parallel to it, commencing at its junction with Yin Chong Street and running in a south-westerly direction for a distance of approximately 35 yards and terminating at the eastern boundary of K.I.L. 1157 R.P. as shown coloured red on Plan No. R.K. 533. English Name: KWONG YUNG STREET. Chinese Name: 廣榮街.
